title: In this city, your shadow is alive

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [mysterious] In this city... your shadow is alive.
lines.caption: In this city your shadow is alive

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: It copies everything you do. Well... almost everything.
lines.caption: It copies everything you do Well almost everything

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [serious] And shadows have one rule. They can NEVER lie.
lines.caption: And shadows have one rule They can NEVER lie

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sighs] Which is a big problem... because I lie a lot.
lines.caption: Which is a big problem because I lie a lot

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [cheerfully] Bean! Try my brand new candy! It's pickle flavored!
lines.caption: Bean! Try my brand new candy! It's pickle flavored!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [forced enthusiasm] Mmm! Wow! It's delicious!
lines.caption: Mmm! Wow! It's delicious!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [flatly] Your shadow is throwing up.
lines.caption: Your shadow is throwing up

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [nervous laugh] He's... dancing!
lines.caption: He's dancing!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [suspicious] Bean. Did you eat my chocolate bar?
lines.caption: Bean Did you eat my chocolate bar?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [innocent] What? No! I would never!
lines.caption: What? No! I would never!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [angry] Your shadow is literally licking its fingers!
lines.caption: Your shadow is literally licking its fingers!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [frustrated] That's it! I don't need you anymore! Go away!
lines.caption: That's it! I don't need you anymore! Go away!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [quietly] So... he did.
lines.caption: So he did

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [excited] No shadow means no snitch! I can say anything!
lines.caption: No shadow means no snitch! I can say anything!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [confident] Max! I can fly. I just don't feel like it today.
lines.caption: Max! I can fly I just don't feel like it today

lines.speaker: max
lines.tts: [amazed] Whoa! That's so cool!
lines.caption: Whoa! That's so cool!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [confident] Mister Pickle, that candy was the best thing I ever ate!
lines.caption: Mister Pickle that candy was the best thing I ever ate!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [touched] Oh, Bean! Then take ALL of them!
lines.caption: Oh Bean! Then take ALL of them!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sad] Lying was easy. But then... the sun started going down.
lines.caption: Lying was easy But then the sun started going down

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sad] Everybody's shadows came out to play...
lines.caption: Everybody's shadows came out to play

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sad] ...except mine.
lines.caption: except mine

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [worried] I looked everywhere.
lines.caption: I looked everywhere

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [softly] Then I found him. At the park. All alone.
lines.caption: Then I found him At the park All alone

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sincere] Hey, buddy... I'm sorry. You were just telling the truth.
lines.caption: Hey buddy I'm sorry You were just telling the truth

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [sincere] No more lies. I promise.
lines.caption: No more lies I promise

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [happy] He came back!
lines.caption: He came back!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [warmly] Aww. I'm so proud of you, Bean.
lines.caption: Aww I'm so proud of you Bean

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [slowly] That's when I noticed something...
lines.caption: That's when I noticed something

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [scared] Dottie... doesn't have a shadow.
lines.caption: Dottie doesn't have a shadow

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [trembling] Dottie... where's your shadow?
lines.caption: Dottie where's your shadow?

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [sweetly] What shadow? [whispers] Don't tell anyone.
lines.caption: What shadow? Don't tell anyone
